# Regenerating the data {#sec-regenerate}

The data are not in the repository (the log is Reddit's to distribute, and it is large). Two scripts rebuild them
from Reddit's release, exactly.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TheChesireCat/rplace-2017 && cd rplace-2017
uv sync                                    # Python environment (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)
gcloud auth login                          # Google Cloud SDK, for gsutil
export GCS_BILLING_PROJECT=<your-project>  # the bucket is requester-pays: ~1 GB of egress is billed to you
make data
```

| Step | Script | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `scripts/01-fetch.py` | Downloads `gs://place_data_share/place_tiles.csv` (993 MiB) and checks its SHA-256. Does nothing if a correct copy is already there. |
| 2 | `scripts/02-condense.py` | Writes `data/placements.parquet`, `data/users.parquet` and `data/palette.parquet`, rebuilds every CSV line from them, and checks that the rebuilt lines equal the original ones byte for byte. Only then does it delete the CSV. |

The result of the check is kept in the repository as `data/02-parity.json`:

## The files

| File | Columns |
|---|---|
| `placements.parquet` | `t_us` (µs since epoch, UTC), `user_id`, `x`, `y`, `color` (palette index); sorted by time |
| `users.parquet` | `user_id` → `user_hash` (the release's hashed account id) |
| `palette.parquet` | `color` → `hex`, `name`, from Reddit's released Place client (`client.js`, `DEFAULT_COLOR_PALETTE`) |

## Building the book

```bash
make preview    # live preview while writing
make render     # run the chapters and build the site into _site/
make publish    # push the site to the gh-pages branch
```

Chapter results are cached in `_freeze/`, which is committed, so the site can be rebuilt without the data. A
chapter is re-run only when its source changes.
